one_sentence_story: Doctors gave adults fake pills and told them zero drug was inside. Taking them twice a day still cut real gut and back pain.
so_what_for_you: Take your care steps with calm focus instead of rushing. Steady daily habits turn on your brain's own pain switch.

jargon_map.plain: A pill with zero drug inside. Doctors tell you straight out that it is fake.

jargon_map.plain: Calm signals from your brain that move down your spine to block ache.
jargon_map.analogy: Like turning down a loud sound right at the wall knob.

jargon_map.plain: Your brain learned from past real pills. Swallowing a pill now unlocks its own pain relief.
